rules.name: routes-are-independent
rules.because: a route module must not depend on another; share code through src/http.ts, src/auth.ts or src/db/

rules.name: no-upward-imports
rules.because: lower layers (http, auth, db) must not import the app, the server or routes

rules.name: pool-injected-from-composition-root
rules.because: only src/server.ts creates the pg Pool; everything else receives it (import type { Pool } is fine)

rules.name: db-layer-is-framework-free
rules.because: migrations and data access must not depend on HTTP or validation libraries
